query: What does secure attachment actually look like?

per_question.q: What does a securely attached person actually do differently after a fight?
per_question.why: B names repair attempts, acceptance of repair, and time-to-repair with Gottman's finding attached; A covers repair but without the observable mechanics.

per_question.q: Why do I still feel anxious in my relationship even after years of working on myself?
per_question.why: A's earned-vs-never-wounded-vs-performed distinction and the receiving-vs-supply machine answer this exact second-arriver question better than anything in B.

per_question.q: Is being calm and low-maintenance the same as being securely attached?
per_question.why: B names the mechanism (avoidant deactivation) and ties it to Main's dismissing classification; A covers the same ground well but without the research anchor.

per_question.q: How do psychologists actually measure adult attachment?
per_question.why: B's AAI vs ECR-R comparison table is the only treatment of measurement in either page; A only waves at quizzes.

per_question.q: Can you become securely attached as an adult?
per_question.why: B grounds earned security in Main's AAI coding and names its counterfeits (suppression, intellectualization, forgiveness); A is strong but less checkable.

per_question.q: What are the green flags of a secure partner in early dating?
per_question.why: B provides an eight-week observable checklist plus non-signals people over-weight; A has no dating-specific section.

per_question.q: Why do compliments make me uncomfortable?
per_question.why: A's receiving machine, the automatic internal rebuttal, and the flat 'say thank you and add nothing' rule are the most direct and practical treatment in either page.

per_question.q: What does secure attachment look like in a child, and what should parents do?
per_question.why: B details Strange Situation reunion behavior and Ainsworth's sensitivity construct; A's FAQ answer is correct but thinner.

per_question.q: Why do I test my partner even when things are going well?
per_question.why: A's testing-vs-trusting section, the self-sealing loop, and the discernment distinction ('if you had to create the situation, you were not observing it') are unmatched in B.

per_question.q: Is it normal for a good, calm relationship to feel boring or flat at first?
per_question.why: A directly addresses calm registering as danger and the recalibration stretch; B never touches this experience.

intent_match: B. The query asks what secure attachment 'actually looks like' — an observable-markers question. B answers with behavior across dating, conflict, parenting, friendship and the body, each tied to named research. A answers the adjacent question (what it feels like from inside, and whether your work counted) brilliantly, but that is a narrower reading of the intent.

A: No treatment of the four attachment principles (proximity, safe haven, secure base, separation distress)
No measurement content: AAI vs self-report instruments never explained
No dating-specific observable checklist or green flags
No physiology of co-regulation, flooding, or conflict timeouts
No disorganized/fearful style coverage and no prevalence estimates
Conflict treatment lacks repair-attempt and time-to-repair mechanics
B: No account of the interpretation loop (signal, interpretation, protective behavior, relief) or why the belief is self-sealing
No receiving-vs-supply distinction explaining why reassurance never closes the gap
No treatment of calm registering as danger, or missing intensity once things settle
No testing-vs-discernment distinction and no boundary/saying-no practice
No concrete self-observation exercise comparable to A's gap log
Never speaks to the reader who has done years of work and still feels the flicker

first_screen: A. The 'run of small non-events' framing plus the verbatim inner-sentence bullets is immediately self-recognizing and earns the scroll; B's first screen is an accurate but encyclopedic definition.
provenance: B. Named researchers with dates, specific instruments, and a checkable sources list, plus a clear educational disclaimer. A names the same core lineage accurately and is honest about its anecdotal portion, but leans on an unverifiable personal narrative (5,000 hours, seminars abroad) that carries no external check.
